scripts.text:
[Training Ground Warehouse Soldier]
Would you like to use the Storage? 1000 Zeny is required to use the training ground Storage. Please select the Storage you wish to use.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
您想使用倉庫嗎？使用訓練場倉庫需要1000 Zeny。請選擇您想使用的倉庫。

scripts.text: �� Storage 1
scripts.translation: 個人倉庫

scripts.text: �� Guild Storage
scripts.translation: 公會倉庫

scripts.text: �� Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Training Ground Warehouse Soldier]
The guild storage is only available for guild members.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
公會倉庫僅對公會成員開放。

scripts.text:
[Training Ground Warehouse Soldier]
It seems that it is not yet possible for your guild to use the guild warehouse or you do not have access permissions for the warehouse.
Please come back after checking the guild skill and the permission to access the warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
看起來您的公會目前無法使用公會倉庫，或者您沒有倉庫的訪問許可權。
請檢查公會技能和倉庫訪問許可權後再來。

scripts.text:
[Training Ground Warehouse Soldier]
I am afraid you do not have enough money to settle the fee.
The fee is 1000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足以支付費用。
費用是1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Training Ground Warehouse Soldier]
I will open the guild storage for you then. Have a memorable time!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
那麼，我將為您開啟公會倉庫。祝您愉快！

scripts.text:
[Training Ground Warehouse Soldier]
I am afraid someone else is using the warehouse right now.
Please try again after a while.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
很抱歉，現在有人正在使用倉庫。
請稍後再試。

scripts.text:
[Training Ground Warehouse Soldier]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
很抱歉，您需要將初心者基本技能等級提升至6級才能使用倉庫服務。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[訓練場倉庫士兵]
^4d4dff使用訓練場倉庫需要1000 Zeny。^000000

scripts.text:
[Neighborhood Grandmother]
Hohoho- Seeing the young people sweating and working hard makes me feel a bit energized.
scripts.translation:
[鄰家老奶奶]
呵呵呵——看著年輕人揮灑汗水、努力工作，我也覺得有點精神了。

scripts.text:
[Neighborhood Grandmother]
Oh, by the way. Did you know that?
scripts.translation:
[鄰家老奶奶]
哦，對了。你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Neighborhood Grandmother]
Dummies in the training grounds that are strong against physical attacks have a sword icon above their heads, and dummies that are strong against magic attacks have a staff icon above their heads.
scripts.translation:
[鄰家老奶奶]
訓練場裡，那些擅長防禦物理攻擊的假人頭頂會有劍的圖示，而擅長防禦魔法攻擊的假人頭頂會有法杖的圖示。

scripts.text:
[Neighborhood Grandmother]
If you know this, you'll be able to hit them harder, right?
scripts.translation:
[鄰家老奶奶]
知道這一點，你就能打出更高的傷害，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Fress]
If you want to go to Prontera, you can exit through the guards located throughout the area or through the warp portals at 3 and 9 o'clock. Seriously.
scripts.translation:
[弗雷斯]
如果你想前往普隆德拉，可以通過分佈在各地的衛兵出口，或者通過3點和9點方向的傳送之陣離開。我是認真的。

scripts.text:
[Nine Oranges]
Remember! Once you've chosen a name, it's hard to change, so choose wisely.
scripts.translation:
[九個橙子]
記住！一旦選擇了名字，就很難更改了，所以要慎重選擇。

scripts.text:
[Nine Oranges]
By the way, where's the Undead Dummy?
scripts.translation:
[九個橙子]
順便問一下，不死系假人在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Nine Oranges]
My friend said it has a bone icon above its head...? You have to see it first.
scripts.translation:
[九個橙子]
我朋友說它頭頂有個骨頭的圖示...？你得先找到它才行。

scripts.text:
[Village ]
Hi! The weather is really nice, isn't it? I came to check out the new training grounds.
scripts.translation:
[村莊]
嗨！天氣真好，不是嗎？我來看看新的訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Village ]
The old training grounds weren't bad, but they were actually renting space that beginners had been using for a long time, so there were some inconveniences.
scripts.translation:
[村莊]
舊訓練場雖然不錯，但其實是租用新手們長期使用的場地，所以有些不便。

scripts.text:
[Village ]
But they're building such a spacious and nice new training ground. It seems like they're quite financially sound these days!
scripts.translation:
[村莊]
但他們正在建造寬敞漂亮的新訓練場。看來最近財務狀況相當不錯！

scripts.text:
[Jar Cat]
Is this your first time at the training grounds? I'll explain myself, as a veteran.
scripts.translation:
[罐子貓]
這是你第一次來訓練場嗎？讓我以老手的身份解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Jar Cat]
There are three training grounds: the basic training ground, the 1/10 training ground, and the 1/100 training ground. I'll leave the differences between each training ground for you to discover for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[罐子貓]
這裡有三個訓練場：基礎訓練場、1/10訓練場和1/100訓練場。至於它們之間的區別，就留給你自己去發現吧。

scripts.text:
[Jar Cat]
Oh, right! To move to another training ground, you can use the warp portals at 3 o'clock and 9 o'clock. Remember!
scripts.translation:
[罐子貓]
對了！要前往其他訓練場，可以使用3點鐘和9點鐘方向的傳送之陣。記住哦！

scripts.text:
[Little One]
Dad told me! The Dummys with staff icons above their heads are strong against magic!
scripts.translation:
[小傢伙]
爸爸告訴我的！頭頂有法杖圖示的假人，對魔法很強！

scripts.text:
[Little One]
So... if you can defeat those Dummys with magic, you're truly strong, right?!
scripts.translation:
[小傢伙]
所以...如果你能用魔法打敗那些假人，那你真的很強，對吧？！

scripts.text:
[Kekekekereurur]
They say training with the Dummys with cat icons above them will help you fight Doram in PvP.
scripts.translation:
[剋剋剋剋雷烏魯爾]
聽說和頭頂有貓圖示的假人訓練，有助於在PvP中對抗多蘭。

scripts.text:
[Kekekekereurur]
I'm definitely not practicing here after getting beat up by a passing Doram. Remember!
scripts.translation:
[剋剋剋剋雷烏魯爾]
我絕對不會再在這裡練習，結果被路過的多蘭打了一頓。記住！

scripts.text:
[Lumberjack]
Whoosh- Cha-Whoosh- Cha-
scripts.translation:
[伐木工]
呼- 唰-呼- 唰-

scripts.text:
[Dong]
Aaaah- Stop! Stop! I'm not a monster. Don't attack me.
scripts.translation:
[東]
啊啊啊- 停手！停手！我不是魔物。別攻擊我。

scripts.text:
[Dong]
Whew- Thank you. Some people often mistake me for the monster Mukka, but I'm a cactus from a place called RockRidge.
scripts.translation:
[東]
呼- 謝謝你。經常有人把我誤認為是魔物穆卡，但我其實是來自洛克裡奇（RockRidge）的仙人掌。

scripts.text:
[Dong]
If you visit RockRidge, you can meet our living, breathing Cacti, the Cactus. Come visit. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[東]
如果你去洛克裡奇，可以見到我們活生生的仙人掌，也就是仙人掌族。歡迎來玩。哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Coco]
?
scripts.translation:
[可可]
？
